verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships a built-in AI Helpbot, opened with cmd/ctrl+K, but it is documented only as answering questions from approved support content. Task-level AI exists as separate single-purpose features: GenAI DDQ questionnaire autofill and First Pass AI evidence pre-screening. The MCP server lets an external assistant act in the workspace, which is not a built-in assistant and earns no credit here. missing for 10: an in-product assistant that takes delegated actions (creating or updating tasks, evidence, or controls), documentation of agentic task execution inside the UI, hands-on or independent corroboration.
